title: How implementable is NotificationAction.icon?
body:
### What is the issue with the Notifications API Standard?

It seems the only working implementation as of now is Chrome for Windows.

1. Windows: The [action schema](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/uwp/schemas/tiles/toastschema/element-action) allows assigning an image via URL.
2. macOS: [UNNotificationActionIcon](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/usernotifications/unnotificationactionicon) only allows either the system icon or the app-bundled image, but not a random generated resource.
3. Linux: ["actions-icons" hint is available](https://specifications.freedesktop.org/notification-spec/latest/protocol.html) but this replaces action text per the spec.
4. Android: Setting icon is possible, but [the doc](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/app/Notification.Action.Builder#Builder(android.graphics.drawable.Icon,%20java.lang.CharSequence,%20android.app.PendingIntent)) says "As of Android [Build.VERSION_CODES.N](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/os/Build.VERSION_CODES#N), action button icons will not be displayed on action buttons"

If the only supported platform is Windows, maybe we should reconsider the inclusion of the feature in the spec.
